title: 说说昨天做了什么
goal: 能用几句简单的话说出昨天或者周末做了什么。

chunks.note: 问过去的事用 did。回答时动词要换成"过去的样子"。

chunks.en: I had dinner with my family.

chunks.note: 很多动词后面加 ed 就是过去：stay → stayed。
am / is 的过去是 was。

chunks.en: Last weekend, I went to the park.
chunks.note: last weekend = 上周末，last night = 昨晚。

grammar.title: 说过去的事，动词要变
grammar.body: 中文说"昨天去""今天去"，"去"字不变；英语说过去的事，动词要换成过去的样子。大多数动词后面加 ed（cook → cooked）。最常用的几个要单独记：go → went，have → had，do → did，am / is → was。

examples.en: Today I go to work. Yesterday I went to work.
examples.zh: 今天我去上班。昨天我去上班了。

examples.en: Today I cook. Yesterday I cooked.
examples.zh: 今天我做饭。昨天我做了饭。

examples.en: I am tired. I was tired yesterday.

dialogue.title: 周一早上聊周末
dialogue.setting: 星期一早上，同事 Mei Ling 问你周末过得怎么样。

npc.en: Morning, Amy! How was your weekend?
npc.zh: 早上好，Amy！周末过得怎么样？

replies.en: I stayed at home and watched TV.

npc.zh: 听起来不错。你做饭了吗？

npc.en: Me, I was so busy on Saturday!
Yes! OK, let's start work. Have a good day!
npc.zh: 是啊！好了，开始干活吧。祝你今天顺利！

task: 今天用英语说三句昨天做了什么，比如 Yesterday, I went to work. 说给自己或者家人听。
